68: ## Phase 4: Error Handling

75: ## Phase 5: Integration

89: ## Phase 6: Testing and Documentation

109: ## Dependencies
110: 
111: ```
112: 1.1, 1.2 → 2.1, 3.1 (types needed first)
113: 2.1 → 2.2 → 2.5 (sequential OpenAI)
114: 2.1 → 2.3, 2.4 (parallel)
115: 3.1 → 3.2 → 3.3 (sequential Anthropic)

123: - Phase 2 (OpenAI) and Phase 3 (Anthropic) can run in parallel after Phase 1

125: - All Phase 6 tasks can run in parallel after Phase 5
